marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind east 15 knots diminishing to light this afternoon then
increasing to west 15 to 20 late this evening. Wind west 15 to 20
Thursday. Showers beginning this evening changing to flurries after
midnight and ending Thursday morning. Fog patches dissipating near
midnight. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 Thursday
morning.<br/>

marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind east 10 to 15 knots becoming light this morning then
increasing to northwest 10 to 15 early this afternoon. Wind increasing to
northwest 15 to 20 this evening then backing to west 15 Thursday
afternoon. Rain late this evening and after midnight changing to snow
and ending late overnight. <br/>
